title: KAITO — Pick A Side!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They seemed really happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They should be since they know what they want to do now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Honami must be so relieved...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She must have felt so much pressure due to the other three having already figured out their aspirations...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The stress alone would've probably given you a stomach ulcer, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh...
It hurts just thinking about it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Actually, I wasn't all that worried about her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Though I did keep an eye out just in case...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, really...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, why weren't you guys worried?
Because you believed she'd figure things out?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's that, but most importantly, I know how strong she's become.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Taking time to figure out the right answer is one thing, but she'd never run away from a problem.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, it's like she's a completely different person now compared to when they got their band back together.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, one of you told me something about how she was afraid of being disliked...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But now, she's able to speak her mind and even puts her foot down when the situation calls for it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. And despite being so worried about not knowing what her aspirations were, she was able to face that question head-on.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's hard to say if she knows this herself, but the way she approached this problem played a big role.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Depending on how optimistically or pessimistically you see things, the stress you experience mentally and the answer you'll arrive upon will differ greatly.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Think of it this way... Having your head hunched means only seeing the ground.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Meanwhile, looking up and walking forward means seeing what's all around you, even the sky above...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which should allow you to see more possibilities and give you more avenues to walk down...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I see. That makes a lot of sense.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, KAITO, you're so brilliant♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, Luka, MEIKO, you're supposed to be her seniors, but what you said seems like something that would come from her mom.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I thought the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Luka & MEIKO
rows.Line: Her mom?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, couldn't you have gone with big sisters instead?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I feel like a mother would feel more compelled to watch over her daughter...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, KAITO, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? M-Me? Why...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because you gave a really good explanation just now! I'm betting you can come up with another amazing thing to say♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to hear what analogy you come up with as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I mean...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to hear what he says, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me neither.
Lay it on us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (So much pressure...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Instead of mother and daughter...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What if you were her teachers...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think you were both in a position to give her the hints she needed to solve this problem... How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow, KAITO, you're a genius...!
“Teachers” fits so much better!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Way to be quick on your feet.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do you think so...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'm impressed as well.
I wasn't expecting you to come up with another analogy so quickly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We might have to start by asking you to break down these sorts of problems moving forward.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What...?
No, you should try to figure them out yourself first.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.
